Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game as no team has been guaranteed a spot in the semi-finals from Group 1. The action in the T20 World Cup continues on the 2nd of November with another doubleheader. In the first game of the day, Zimbabwe will take on the Netherlands in Adelaide and that game will begin at 9.30 am IST (4 am GMT). The second game is a clash between two Asian teams as India play Bangladesh and the game will begin at 1.30 pm IST (8 am GMT). The build-up for both those games will begin much sooner. Do join us then. Cheers!

Jos Buttler the winning captain is also the Player of the Match for his 73 runs in just 47 deliveries. He says that they had a poor performance in the last game but they had the belief to turn things around. Adds that in these tournaments you expect to be under pressure and it can be ruthless as we saw South Africa going out despite winning four out of their five games in the last World Cup. Mentions that the wicket was a bit tricky and praises Alex Hales for his knock. Tells that it is always nice to look back at things like this (On going past Eoin Morgan as the highest scorer for England in T20Is). Also, credits Moeen Ali for the way he bowled and put New Zealand under pressure. Further says that in T20 cricket you need to be patient and keep backing your players. It is important to encourage them. Says that they were aiming for 160-165, but they were happy to go beyond that. Tells that batting first was the right decision and the early wickets helped too. Ends by saying that their focus will be to win against Sri Lanka.

Kane Williamson the captain of New Zealand credits England for the way they played and says that they struggled to get a breakthrough early. Adds that Jos Buttler and Alex Hales were outstanding at the top of the order and that their opponents were far more clinical than they were. Claims that they tried to take the game deep and they had their moments but they fell short. About the dropped catches he agrees that they can't give lives to quality players as they will make you pay. Adds that he thought he had the ball clamped in his arms but the replays showed otherwise and it was a bit embarrassing. Mentions that Glenn Phillips was outstanding and has now played two good innings in difficult conditions. Ends by saying that they will always be put under pressure in big competitions and they hope to take confidence into the next game.
Time for the presentation...

In the first inning, England got off to a flier with their openers putting on an 81-run partnership as they both reached their half-century. Jos Buttler top-scored with 73 but the Kiwi spinners did well to pull the game back and restrict their opponents to under 180. They were, however, unable to take the momentum into their batting and despite Glenn Phillips's heroics they have fallen well short of the target.

New Zealand did not get off to a good start as Devon Conway could not make the most of a close shave as he got dismissed soon after getting a stumping scare. Finn Allen got off to a start but could not get going and once his wicket fell Kane Williamson got together with Glen Phillips to put on a 91-run partnership of just 59 balls. They had set a good platform by consolidating before the Drinks break and taking the attack to the bowlers after the interval. However, once Kane Williamson departed on a run-a-ball 40, it was difficult for the new batters to accelerate immediately. The dismissal of Glenn Phillips on 62 all but sealed the deal as the target seemed too far away for the lower-order batters.

England were right on top of their opponents right from the word go operating with spin from one end and pace from the other. Chris Woakes claimed a wicket in his first over and Sam Curran came on to dismiss the other opener. A dropped catch from Moeen Ali proved to be expensive as New Zealand began building a partnership that threatened to take the game away from them. Ben Stokes was brought into the attack for one over and it proved to be a masterstroke as he broke the partnership which caused the new batters to collapse under the pressure. The pace bowlers claimed all the wickets as Sam Curran and Chris Woakes picked up two wickets each with Mark Wood and Ben Stokes chipping in with one each.

England have kept their hopes alive with a complete performance! New Zealand at one point looked like they could push for the target but they lost 4 wickets for 40 runs towards the end and have fallen short by 20 runs. The win for England has blown the group open with four teams fighting for two semi-final spots and things have gotten really interesting. New Zealand will be disappointed in missing out on an opportunity to confirm the spot in the knockouts but they still claim the top spot in the group courtesy of a superior net run rate.
A single to end the innings! Sam Curran bowls another good yorker, on leg, Mitchell Santner squeezes it towards long on for a single. ENGLAND WIN BY 20 RUNS!
Sam Curran bangs in a bouncer, on middle and leg, Mitchell Santner misses his pull shot.
Sam Curran nails the yorker this time, on middle and leg, Mitchell Santner digs it back to the bowler.
This is full and on leg, Mitchell Santner drills it towards long on for a brace.

WIDE! Sam Curran loses his line and serves this full delivery down the leg, Mitchell Santner misses his flick and the ball goes through to the keeper. Jos Buttler takes a review to save the wide, but UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Wided.
This is on a length and on off, Ish Sodhi drags this towards deep mid-wicket for a single. New Zealand need 25 runs in 4 balls now.
Swing and a miss! This is full and outside off, slower too, Ish Sodhi swings wildly but misses.
SIX! BANG! Chris Woakes bowls a slower one, on a length and on off, Mitchell Santner stays there and pulls it over the long on fence for a biggie. New Zealand need 26 runs in the last over.
WIDE! Chris Woakes loses his line and serves this length ball way outside off, Mitchell Santner leaves it alone. Wided.
Chris Woakes pithces it up, on leg, Mitchell Santner chips it down to long on for a couple of runs.
This is full and on off, Mitchell Santner lofts it towards long on for a brace.
Ish Sodhi gives the charge and Chris Woakes bangs a hard-length delivery, on leg, angling in, Sodhi misses and gets hit high on his body. A leg bye is taken.
Short of a length and outside off, Mitchell Santner cuts it over point for a single.
A slower one, on a length and on off, Ish Sodhi lofts it towards long on for a single.
Sam Curran bowls this short and outside off, Ish Sodhi looks to pull but only manages to get it to long on for a single.
Bowls this close to the batter on a good length, Mitchell Santner is cramped for room and works this down to long on for one.
Sam Curran welcomes Ish Sodhi with a short ball going down leg, Ish Sodhi looks to pull and gets a top edge over short fine leg as the batters are able to complete three runs.

OUT! TAKEN! Sam Curran gets the big fish, Glenn Phillips! That could be it for New Zealand and England are delighted. Sam Curran bowls this a touch fuller and on middle, in the slot, Glenn Phillips goes for the big slog, but miscues his shot straight up in the air towards long on where Chris Jordan takes another good catch. England are right on top!
Commentary.Howout: c sub Chris Jordan b Sam Curran

Commentary.Commentary: Sam Curran bowls this short and follows the batter to the leg side, Mitchell Santner pulls this away from mid-wicket and takes a single.

Sam Curran begins the over with a back-of-a-length delivery outside off, Glenn Phillips unches trhis to deep cover and some good fielding in the deep saves a run and allows the batters to take three runs.
Mitchell Santner makes his way out to the middle and will need to support Glenn Phillips who looks in fine form at the other end.

OUT! TAKEN! Chris Woakes gets his second wicket and sends Daryl Mitchell back to the hut. He bowls another slower one, bit full and on leg, Daryl Mitchell looks to loft it over the long on fence, but hits it with the bottom part of the bat. As a result, he fails to get the eleavtion and Chris Jordan (Sub) takes a nice catch moving to his right. New Zealand still need 49 runs in 18 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Chris Jordan b Chris Woakes

Commentary.Commentary: Chris Woakes bowls a slower bouncer, on middle, Glenn Phillips pulls it towards deep square leg for just a single.
A slower one now, on a length and on middle, Glenn Phillips only manages to push it back to the bowler.

Chris Woakes lands this short and on middle, Daryl Mitchell pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. He bowls amother slower one, bit fuller and on leg, Daryl Mitchell looks to loft it over the long on fence, but hits it with the bottom half of the bat. As a result, he fails to get elevation and Chris Jordan (Sub) takes a nice catch moving to his right. New Zealand sti;; need 49 off 18 ball now.
On a length again and on off, Daryl Mitchell works it towards deep square leg for a couple of runs. The throw needed to be better at the batter's end to cause in any trouble.
This is on a good length and on middle, Glenn Phillips pushes it towards cover for single.
Swing and a miss! Mark Wood goes for the short delivery again and bowls this outside off, Daryl Mitchell tries for the pull shot but cannot connect.
On a length and on off, Daryl Mitchell guides it towards point.
Daryl Mitchell is the new batter at the crease.

OUT! TAKEN! Mark Wood strikes! England are back in the game with two wickets in two over. Mark Wood bangs this short and on middle, James Neesham gets hurried and miscues his pull shot in the air towards deep mid-wicket where Sam Curran takes a nice catch moving to his left. New Zealand lose their fourth.
Commentary.Howout: c Sam Curran b Mark Wood

Commentary.Commentary: Mark Wood bowls this on a good length and on leg, angling in, James Neesham works it towards square leg for a couple of runs.
This is on a hard length and on leg, Glenn Phillips awkwardly pulls it through square leg for a single.
Swing and a miss! Mark Wood bangs this short and on middle, Glenn Phillips goes for the pull shot but gets beaten by the pace.
Mark Wood has been brought back into the attack.

FOUR! James Neesham gets off the mark in style! Ben Stokes bowls a short ball outside off to welcome the new batter and James Neesham does not need a second invitation to slap this towards deep mid-wicket for four runs.
James Neesham walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ben Stokes gets a breakthrough in his first over and the New Zealand skipper has to depart! Ben Stokes takes some pace off the ball and bowls this on a good length outside the off stump. Kane Williamson looks to guide this fine but gets beaten by the pace. He manages to lob this towards short third man where Adil Rashid dives forward and take an easy catch. Kane Williamson played the roll on an anchor but his departure now means that the new batter will have to go after the bowlers right from the start.
Commentary.Howout: c Adil Rashid b Ben Stokes

Commentary.Commentary: Goes full and wide outside the off pole, Glenn Phillips looks to gets across the stumps and scoop this over the keeper but does not get a hold of it. Miscues his shot to short third man and they take a single.
This is bowled full and outside off, Glenn Phillips hits this really hard straight to the cover fielder.
FOUR! Glenn Phillips looking really dangerous here! Ben Stokes bangs this in short and angling down leg, Glenn Phillips helps it along its way over the short fine leg fielder for four runs.
New Zealand have started to change gears now, and this is going to be an exciting end to the chase. England need to break this partnership quickly.
This is on a good length and nipping back into the batter from just outside off, Kane Williamson works this toward cover and takes a run.
Bowls a quicker delivery full and into the pads, Kane Williamson taps this towards mid on and takes a quick run to keep strike.
This is closer to the stumps on a shorter length, Glenn Phillips punches this to long off and takes one.

That brings up a quick-fire half-century for Glenn Phillips! Adil Rashid goes back to bowling short and outside off, Glenn Phillips hits this off his back foot towards deep cover for a couple of runs.
SIX! Make that two maximums in a row! Adil Rashid decides to flight this one full and outside off, Glenn Phillips gets on one knee and sweeps this over deep square leg for six more runs.

SIX! Glenn Phillips looking to get in offensive mode here against the spinner! Adil Rashid drops the ball short and in line with the stumps, Glenn Phillips pulls this over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. That brings up the 100 for New Zealand.
Adil Rashid begins the over with a short ball in line with the stumps, Kane Williamson rocks back and plays this to wide long on for a run.
Adil Rashid (3-0-16-0) replaces Mark Wood.
Goes full and attempts a yorker but strays onto the pads, Glenn Phillips clips this to deep backward square leg and get two more runs.

Sam Curran goes short once again and continues to bowl outside off, Glenn Phillips goes for the pulls shot but does not get a hold of it and the ball goes towards deep mid-wicket. They run outstandingly well to complete a coule of runs.
Bangs this in short and outside off, Glenn Phillips looks to pull but is unable to connect.
Full and on the pads, Glenn Phillips clips this to wide long on and looks for two. There is no second but a direct hit from the deep allowed them to get a brace.
Goes a fraction full and outside off, Kane Williamson works this to deep point and take a single.
WIDE! This is down leg side on a good length. The keeper does not collect cleanly as he slips and they take an extra run. The umpire calls this wide as the batter leaves it alone.
Sam Curran bowls this on a good length and down leg side, Kane Williamson makes room and plays this towards cover to give Glenn Phillips the strike with a single.
Sam Curran is back on. He conceded 2 runs in his first over and picked up a wicket.
Another delivery bowled back of a length and outside off, Kane Williamson taps this towards cover-point and takes another quick single.
Delivers this on a good length and outside off, Glenn Phillips taps this toward cover and takes a quick single.
This is back-of-a-length and outside the off stump, Glenn Phillips blocks this towards point.

SIX! That has been dispatched and it should release some of the pressure! Mark Wood goes full and just outside the off pole, Glenn Phillips keeps his head still and flicks the ball over deep mid-wicket for a huge hit.
Bangs this in short and in line with the stumps, Glenn Phillips does well to duck under this one.

This is on a good length and in line with the stumps, Glenn Phillips looks to block and gets an inside edge towards deep backward square leg for a couple of runs. With that, the 50-run partnership comes up between these two batters.
Mark Wood comes back into the attack. He conceded 12 runs in his first over.
Full and attacking the stumps, Kane Williamson thumps it back towards the bowler who stops the ball with his foot.
In line with the stumps on a fuller length, Kane Williamson top edges his sweep shot and the ball goes behind the keeper as they take a couple of runs.
This is flighted full and outside off, Glenn Phillips strokes this to long off for a run.

FOUR! A lucky boundary for Glenn Phillips and England have not kept a slip at all this game. This is flighted full and outside off, Glenn Phillips pushes at the ball and gets a thick edge that flies to third man for four runs.
Bowls this slightly short and outside off, Kane Williamson uses the crease and works this down to long on for a single.
Liam Livingstone bowls a low full toss on the pads, Kane Williamson clips this towards deep mid-wicket and they take two runs.

DRINKS! England will be absolutely thrilled with their effort so far as they have not only dismissed the dangerous New Zealand openers but also chocked the flow of runs. They are far ahead in this game but will not take this lightly as they know a few good overs for their opponents could change the tide against them. The dropped catch of Glenn Phillips could prove to be expensive. The Kiwis need to get going soon if there are to mount a challenge of achieving the target as they definitely have the capabilities to do so. England are ahead at this stage but the game could go either way after the break.
Floated, full and on leg, Kane Williamson flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.

DROPPED! Moeen Ali drops a sitter! Adil Rashid flights this up, on off, turning away a bit, Glenn Phillips goes for the slog-sweep, but miscues his shot in the air towards cover where Moeen Ali runs to his left, but spills it out. It was a very casual effort from Ali and Adil Rashid cannot believe it. Glenn Phillips was dropped in the last game and went on to score a hundred. Can he do something like that again?
Shorter in length and on off, Kane Williamson punches it off the back foot towards cover for single.
Quicker delivery, on middle, Kane Williamson knocks it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, full and on leg, Glenn Phillips works it through square leg for a single.
A bit short and on off, Glenn Phillips moves back and pushes it towards cover-point.

FOUR! A much-needed boundary for New Zealand! This is tossed up, full and on off, Kane Williamson drives it firmly wide of long off where Harry Brook dives to his left but cannot stop it from going to the boundary.
Quicker one, short and on off, Kane Williamson uses his feet but only manages to steer it towards point.
Flatter, full and on middle, Glenn Phillips clips it towards square leg for a single.
Flighted delivery, on leg, Kane Williamson makes room and knocks it towards point for a single.
Tossed up, full and on off, Kane Williamson drives it past cover for a brace.
Liam Livingstone bowls this full and just outside off, Glenn Phillips works this through cover-point for a single.
Goes short and outside off, Kane Williamson moves back and forces it wide of long off for a couple of runs.
Floated, full and on middle, Kane Williamson mistimes his drive back to the bowler.
Tossed up, full and on off, Glenn Phillips looks to play at it but gets an outside edge towards short third man for a single.
Short again and outside off, Glenn Phillips cuts it wide of deep point for a brace. 50 up fro New Zealand!
Looped up, full and on off, Kane Williamson goes inside-out and chips it towards deep extra cover for a single.
Short and on off, Kane Williamson mistimes his cut towards backward point.
FOUR! Nice placement! Thsi is short again and outside off, Glenn Phillips stays there and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Liam Livingstone continues with the shorter length, on off, Kane Williamson pushes it toward cover for a single.
Quicker one, short and on off, Glenn Phillips goes for the cut, but gets an outside edge, and Jos Buttler stretches his leg to parry it towards short third man. A single is taken.
Shortish and on off, Glenn Phillips pushes it towards point again.
Short again and on off, Kane Williamson guides it towards backward point for a quick single.
Liam Livingstone starts with a short delivery, on off, Kane Williamson cuts it towards point.

EDGED AND FOUR! Mark Wood bowls this full and on middle at 155 clicks, Glenn Phillips is a bit late to put his down to block it, but gets an inside edge just past the stumps towards fine leg fence for a boundary.
This is on a good length and on off, Kane Williamson waits for it and guides it towards third man for a single.
Pulls his length back a bit, on middle, Kane Williamson knocks it towards mid on.
FOUR! Nicely timed! Mark Wood serves this full and on the pads again, Kane Williamson uses the pace and flicks it away wide of fine leg for a boundary.
On a length and around leg, Kane Williamson tucks it towards mid-wicket.
WIDE! This is full and down the leg side, Kane Williamson misses his flick. Wided.
Mark Wood starts with a good-length delivery, on leg, Kane Williamson flicks it towards square leg where the fielder lets it through. Two runs taken!
Glenn Phillips comes out to the middle now. Mark Wood has been brought into the attack.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sam Curran strikes and gets rid of the dangerous Finn Allen! He bowls this one back of a length and outside off, Finn Allen is tempted into the pull shot but is unable to get into a good position. He mishits the ball as it goes high toward deep mid-wicket. Ben Stokes comes running in from the boundary and takes a fine catch. He seems to have shut his fingers in early and hurt them as he is seen grimacing. Sam Curran is thrilled with his wicket and England have their second.
Commentary.Howout: c Ben Stokes b Sam Curran

Commentary.Commentary: Nails the yorker outside the off stump, Finn Allen looks to dig this out but is unable to connect as the ball goes through to the keeper.
Delivers this outside the off pole on a good length once again. Kane Williamson works this to deep point and takes a run.
This is on a good length and just outside the off pole, Kane Williamson looks to pull but the ball is not short enough and gets beaten on the under edge.
Bowls this outside leg and pulls his length back as he sees the batter charging down the wicket. Finn Allen has to adjust and mistimes his pull towards mid-wicket for a single.
Sam Curran begins with a good-length delivery angling away from outside off, Finn Allen hits this on the bounce to the mid off fielder.
Sam Curran comes into the attack now.

FOUR! Really poor delivery from Chris Woakes and the ball gets the treatment it deserves! Chris Woakes bowls a half-tracker angling down leg, Kane Williamson pulls and works this ball past the short fine leg fielder to collect four runs for himself.
Continues bowling on a good length and attacking the stumps, Kane Williamson shimmies down the wicket and taps this towards cover.
Bowls this one on a good length and in line with the stumps, Kane Williamson defends this towards mid-wicket.
Goes full once again and into the pads, Finn Allen flicks this towards deep square leg for a single.

SIX! Finn Allen has hit this one-handed over the ropes for a maximum! Chris Woakes bowls a slower delivery full and just outside off, Finn Allen charges down the wicket and heaves this over the deep square leg boundary for six runs.
Chris Woakes bowls this on a god length but strays onto the pads, Kane Williamson clips this to deep square leg and takes a single.
Another flighted delivery bowled outside the off stump on a fuller length, Kane Williamson strokes this to long off and collects a run.
Quicker delivery bowled full and on a leg stump line, Kane Williamson defends this to the right of the bowler.
Loopy delivery bowled full and in line with the stumps, Finn Allen goes for the reverse sweep and plays this past the point fielder for three runs.
Tosses this one up once again and outside the off pole, Kane Williamson uses his wrist and works this to mid-wicket for a single to get off the mark.
Flighted full and just outside off, Kane Williamson gets his front foot forward and defends this to the left of the bowler.
Adil Rashid begins with a shortish delivery outside off, Finn Allen rocks back and hits this towards cover-point. They take a quick single to rotate strike.
Kane Williamson walks out to bat at number 3. Also, Adil Rashid replaces Moeen Ali.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Devon Conway has to make the long walk back to the shed this time! Chris Woakes gets his man as he bangs in a short ball going down leg side, Devon Conway gets across the line of the stumps and looks to pull this fine. He only manages to get his glove on this and Jos Buttler takes a fine catch diving to his right. England have drawn first blood and they are right on top of the opponents.
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Chris Woakes

Commentary.Commentary: This is on a good length and just outside off, Devon Conway defends this toward the cover fielder.
Bowls this on a fuller length and in line with the stumps, Finn Allen clips this to mid-wicket and they take a run.
Goes full this time and on the pads, Devon Conway misses his flick and they take a leg bye as the ball goes off the pads towards square leg.
Bowls this a fraction short and outside off, Devon Conway pulls this towards deep mid-wicket a picks up a couple of runs.
Chris Woakes bowls this on a good length and outside off, Devon Conway knocks this back towards the bowler.
Chris Woakes to bowl from the other end.

Induces an edge this time but there is no slip! Moeen Ali loops this full and outside off, Devon Conway gets a thick outside edge as he looks to block and they take a single as the ball goes to third man.
Flights this one full and outside the off stump, Devon Conway gets beaten by some extra bounce as the ball lofts up towards point.
This is fired in on a fuller length, Devon Conway looks to defend and gets an inside edge onto his back pad.

CLOSE CALL! Devon Conway just about manages to survive! Moeen Ali floats this one full and outside off from around the wicket. Devon Conway leans forward and drags his back leg out as he looks to push at the ball. The ball goes past the outside edge and Jos Buttler removes the bails off in a flash. They go upstairs to check and there in no spike on UltraEdge. The side angles show that Devon Conway gets his foot back just in time.
Another flighted delivery bowled full and outside the off stump, Finn Allen shimmies down the wicket and works this ball to long on for one.
Moeen Ali starts off with a full delivery outside off, Finn Allen clips this to deep mid-wicket and gets off the mark with a brace.
